JOYSTAR Minifat 20" Fat Tire Kids Mountain Bike
Conquer any terrain with the JOYSTAR Minifat. Whether your young adventurer is navigating neighborhood paths or exploring rugged trails of sand, mud, and snow, the Minifat provides the ultimate stability and traction for a unique "floaty" ride.

The Minifat: Built to grab traction on every adventure.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Engineered for all-terrain mastery, the Minifat combines wide-tire stability with the precision of a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain."
Superior Control on All Terrain
Equipped with 20" x 3.0" pneumatic fat tires, the Minifat offers a wider contact patch for incredible grip and stability. To ensure safety during off-road excursions, the bike features Dual Mechanical Disc Brakes, providing reliable and powerful stopping performance in varied conditions.

Precision braking and shifting for confident trail riding.

Key Features & Benefits

7-Speed Shimano Drivetrain: Features a Shimano rear derailleur and easy-to-use twist shifter for smooth hill climbing and versatile speed.

All-Terrain Dominance: 3-inch wide fat tires allow for riding on sand, mud, and snow where standard tires struggle.

Durable Construction: Built with a rugged Hi-Ten Steel frame designed for real riding adventures.

Adjustable Comfort: Includes a quick-release comfort saddle to accommodate growing riders.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Get riding faster with JOYSTAR's streamlined setup. Like our other models, the Minifat is designed for efficiency, with most orders processed within 48 hours and clear assembly instructions provided to get you on the trail quickly.

Assembly Guide: Quick setup to get your young rider moving.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Watch the Minifat handle the terrain with ease.

Our Guarantee
We stand by our bikes so you can ride with peace of mind:

Lifetime Warranty: We offer a lifetime warranty on the frame to the original purchaser.

Authenticity Guaranteed: All bikes are 100% authentic JOYSTAR products.
